'''''Ahrman''''' was a group of three [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttles]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shuttles arrived to fight a single [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] but were all destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fighters. The events surrounding the shuttles was then used in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]], one of them was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
